blocks.text: CAINTA, Rizal — Three of the country’s top tenpin bowlers brought a thrilling and exciting finish to the 28th Strike Lane Elite Bowlers Association, Inc. (Sletba) Open championships on Sunday. Merwin Tan, Kenneth Chua, and Marc Custodio, all mainstays of the national team who had represented the country several times in international bowling competitions, had to fight tooth and nail to win the tournament’s main event, the Mixed Open Masters division. Tan, Custodio and Chua, in that order, actually topped the eight-game elimination series of the finals held at the Sta. Lucia East Grand Mall Bowling Center here to set the […]...
